topicsIntro: I speak about the future of food, cultivated meat and alternative proteins, AI-enabled operations, supply chain transformation, women in business and the realities of scaling businesses in India, drawing on work at Amazon, Snapdeal, Addverb and ClearMeat. Recent stages include Gulfood, the Superwomen Supply Chain Conference and Amazon's Diversity and Inclusion for Women kickoff.
